name: Agatha's Agony: An Amor-less Adventure
source:
Poor Agatha Molla just can't catch a break. After being struck by an ambulance, she wakes up as a patient in a psychiatric hospital with unfamiliar faces. Even worse, she's given experimental medication that makes her hornier and angrier than ever. Can Doctor Molla, the famous surgeon with a heart of ice, successfully woo these simpletons? Probably not, hence Agatha's Agony.
